test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

No sooner did Mr. Piyush Mishra finish his chemistry lecture __that the students began to leave__.

options.text: so the students began to leave.
then the students began to leave.
and the students began to leave.
than the students began to leave.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses the structure "No sooner...than" to indicate that one event happened immediately after another.
 
• In this case, the correct conjunction to use after "No sooner" is "than".
 
• Therefore, the correct substitution for the underlined segment is "than the students began to leave".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"No sooner did Mr. Piyush Mishra finish his chemistry lecture than the students began to leave."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "so the students began to leave" – This option does not fit the structure "No sooner...than".
 
• **Option 2:** "then the students began to leave" – This option is incorrect as "then" is not used with "No sooner".
 
• **Option 3:** "and the students began to leave" – This option is incorrect as "and" is not used with "No sooner".
